snippets.title: Curve Page Transition
snippets.description: A colored SVG panel with a curved leading edge sweeps over the page, swaps the content while it's fully hidden, then sweeps away again — a framework-free take on the 'wipe' route transitions popular on portfolio sites.

snippets.title: Slide-Cover Page Transition
snippets.description: Slide a panel up to cover the outgoing page while it shrinks back in perspective, swap the content underneath, then slide the panel away to reveal it — pure CSS transitions orchestrated by a few lines of JS.

snippets.title: Hover Carousel Nav Link
snippets.description: Turn any nav link into a two-line 'carousel' that rolls a duplicate label in on hover, with a dot-to-bar underline animating underneath — as dependency-free vanilla JS, or a Framer Motion React/Next.js component. Wire up a whole nav bar with one call per link either way.

snippets.title: Side Menu with Hover Image Teasers
snippets.description: A side-menu nav where hovering a link slides a full-size themed panel out from behind the menu — a preview of where that link leads before you click it.

snippets.title: Dot-to-Underline Hover Link
snippets.description: A small dot beneath a nav link fades in, then stretches into a full underline bar on hover — and mirrors the whole thing in reverse on the way out.

snippets.title: Infinite Text Parallax
snippets.description: Repeating rows of text drift sideways at different rates as the page scrolls past them — the marquee-style parallax popular on agency and portfolio hero sections, in about 30 dependency-free lines.

snippets.title: Infinite Text Parallax (Next.js)
snippets.description: The same scroll-linked marquee as a copy-paste React/Next.js component — drop it in components/ui, pass it a list of rows, and Framer Motion drives the transform off real scroll progress.

snippets.title: Sticky Cursor
snippets.description: A custom round cursor that snaps to the center of any hoverable element and stretches toward the pointer like a magnet — includes a draggable touch handle so the effect works without a mouse.

snippets.title: Sticky Cursor (Next.js)
snippets.description: The same magnetic sticky cursor as a copy-paste React/Next.js component — pass it a list of target refs and Framer Motion's spring drives the follow, rotate, and stretch.

snippets.title: Page-Load Intro Animation (GSAP)
snippets.description: A hero's heading, subheading, and CTA button slide up and fade in one after another the moment the page loads — a single staggered GSAP tween instead of several hand-timed CSS animations.

snippets.title: Reveal Footer
snippets.description: A footer that's completely invisible until visitors scroll all the way through the page, then gets uncovered like a curtain lifting away — a fixed footer, an opaque content wrapper on top of it, and one spacer element kept in sync with the footer's real height.

snippets.title: Reveal Footer (Next.js)
snippets.description: The same curtain-style footer reveal as a copy-paste React/Next.js component — wrap your page content and footer content as props and a small `useEffect` keeps a spacer in sync with the footer's real height.
